nodes.description: IERC1155 public nft token contract address set in constructor to 0x13bAb10a88fc5F6c77b87878d71c9F1707D2688A; used as the external NFT contract for balanceOf and safeTransferFrom.
uint256 public price = 0.25 ether; per-unit sale price used in the msg.value check via price.mul(amount).
uint256 public id = 46; the ERC1155 token id sold and queried in supply().
address payable public multisig; recipient of the contract balance transferred after each purchase.
uint256 public start; sale start timestamp enforced by the block.timestamp >= start check.
constructor(address payable _multisig, uint256 _start) initializing multisig, start, nft and id.
buy(uint256 amount) public payable; validates caller, timing, supply and payment, transfers NFT to msg.sender, then forwards the whole balance to multisig.
supply() public view returns(uint256); returns nft.balanceOf(address(this), id).
onERC1155Received external pure callback returning the ERC1155 receiver selector; reachable during the NFT transfer.
Caller-controlled address; used in the msg.sender == tx.origin check, as NFT receiver and as the Buy event buyer.
Miner-influenced timestamp compared against the start variable to gate the sale.
Transaction origin used to enforce the no-contracts check msg.sender == tx.origin.
External call nft.safeTransferFrom(address(this), msg.sender, id, amount, new bytes(0x0)); can invoke an arbitrary receiver callback and is executed before the balance transfer.
External value call multisig.transfer(address(this).balance) sending the entire contract balance to the multisig address.
Arithmetic price.mul(amount) computing the required payment; multiplication of a storage price by a user-supplied amount.
User-supplied amount parameter of buy(uint256 amount).
Constructor parameter assigning the multisig payout address.
Constructor parameter assigning the sale start timestamp.

edges.reason: The user-supplied amount is multiplied by the stored price in price.mul(amount), directly determining the payment requirement.
The stored price state variable is an operand of the price.mul(amount) arithmetic operation.
The amount parameter is passed as the transfer quantity to nft.safeTransferFrom.
msg.sender is the receiver of the external safeTransferFrom call, allowing a malicious caller to be notified and reenter.
The nft state variable is the target contract of the external safeTransferFrom call.
The id state variable is supplied as the ERC1155 token id for the transfer.
The multisig state variable is the destination address of the balance transfer.
msg.sender participates in the msg.sender == tx.origin access-control guard that gates buy().
tx.origin is used in the msg.sender == tx.origin guard, giving tx.origin control over whether buy() executes.
block.timestamp gates execution through the block.timestamp >= start requirement.
The start state variable is the threshold compared against block.timestamp in the sale timing check.
buy() invokes the external safeTransferFrom before transferring the contract balance, an external call inside the function flow.
buy() performs an external value transfer to multisig after the NFT external call.
The external NFT transfer executes before multisig.transfer, so a reentrant call can race the outgoing balance transfer.
The external safeTransferFrom calls the receiver's onERC1155Received callback, which is an entry point for reentrancy.
supply() reads the nft state variable to query the contract's token balance.
supply() reads the id state variable when calling nft.balanceOf.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter is solely consumed by buy() and its internally inlined operations; it has no independent identity outside the function's data flow.
The _multisig parameter only exists to initialize the multisig state variable inside the constructor.
The _start parameter only exists to initialize the start state variable inside the constructor.
